verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm per-second billing for both Pods and Serverless ('billed by the second for compute and storage', 'billed from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second') and describe a credit-based system where charges are only deducted as resources are used, with scale-to-zero for idle workers. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of billing accuracy beyond vendor docs.
